description: dotnet new templates for Strawhats.Framework: backends — strawhats-api (a clean-architecture API with built-in authentication), strawhats-microservice (CQRS, EF Core, outbox, service-to-service auth), strawhats-authserver (an OAuth2/OIDC authorization server); and UIs in your choice of framework — strawhats-blazor / strawhats-angular (a UI for a Strawhats API) and strawhats-blazor-oidc / strawhats-angular-oidc (sign in via the auth server over OpenID Connect).
title: Strawhats.Framework Templates
